notes: Edit freely (Crafted gear card > Edit crafted rules). 'ilvl' is the crafted item level tested (331 = max, Myth crafts with Mistcrests). 'statPairs' are crafted_stats ids: 32 crit, 36 haste, 40 versatility, 49 mastery. 'embellishments' are keyed by the lowercase name used in simc's embellishment table; 'slots' use simc slot names ('finger' = both rings). Slots come from community guides (Level Upper) and are UNVERIFIED for entries marked in 'unverified'. 'extraItems' lets you add craftable base items by hand, e.g. {"id": 239664, "name": "Arcanoweave Cord", "slot": "waist"}; they are used even if the automatic recipe scan finds nothing.
